title: Network Theme Kit inner pages, pass A: About, Services, Meetups and Programs
detail: Four NetworkKitInner blocks (story, organizers, service rows, a filtered index of meetups or programs that draws the Space's live events and programs and falls back to cards typed in the editor), each with a role and layout line; a photo layout on the shared NetworkKitStats and a compact card on the shared NetworkKitCTA, so no role gets a second block; one sheet under the kit theme attribute (components/sites/network-kit-inner/inner-css.ts, contract tokens for structure) layered into the kit skin; and four page builders (components/sites/network-kit-inner/pages.ts) in the voice guide's words: no seeded counts, prices or rhythms. The design's Journeys list stacks full-width cards because its grid style was lost, so the index uses the two-column grid its Workshops page has. The design's events calendar widget is left out of Meetups: the index lists the same events. Registering the pages in the profile kits is the Network kit registration pass. Pass B follows.

verify.evidence: network-kit-inner.tsx exports the four blocks, the sheet is in the kit skin and the four pages exist.
